val acceptContract = Node.contract(accept)("AcceptContract",
  "A person accepts their open invitation to a document or folder: they then have a share of it at the invitation's level, in place of any share of it they had, and the invitation goes. Without an open invitation, nothing changes.",
  why = "Q7: an invitation gives no access until it is accepted, and only while it is open; accepting is what makes the share.",
  idea = "Invitations"
)((lib, t, p, what, result) =>
  result === lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
    lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
      invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what)))))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(withCat, now, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "Cat accepts Ann's invitation, sent a day ago: she may view the plan"),
    expect(withCat, now + 7 * day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), withCat, "eight days after it was sent the invitation has lapsed"),
    expect(withCat, now, bob, Target.Doc(plan), withCat, "Bob was not invited"),
    reject(withCat, now + 7 * day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "a lapsed invitation is never accepted"))

values.d7e10ef6b66ad946:
## Invitations

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can invite a person to it, at a level,
and withdraw the invitation. An invitation gives no access until the person
accepts it; accepting it makes the share. An invitation can be accepted for 7
days after it is sent; then it lapses, and housekeeping removes it.

val acceptContract = Node.contract(accept)("AcceptContract",
  "A person accepts their open invitation to a document or folder: they then have a share of it at the invitation's level, in place of any share of it they had, and the invitation goes. Without an open invitation, or when the document is their own (their share of it is the owner's), nothing changes.",
  why = "Q7: an invitation gives no access until it is accepted, and only while it is open; accepting is what makes the share. Q14: nothing replaces an owner's share of their own document, so an owner invited to it keeps their edit share for good.",
  idea = "Invitations"
)((lib, t, p, what, result) =>
  result === lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
    ownedBy(lib, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)).fold(lib,
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))))
  .under(invitationsAreOffers)
  .examples()(
    expect(withCat, now, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "Cat accepts Ann's invitation, sent a day ago: she may view the plan"),
    expect(withCat, now + 7 * day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), withCat, "eight days after it was sent the invitation has lapsed"),
    expect(withCat, now, bob, Target.Doc(plan), withCat, "Bob was not invited"),
    expect(annInvited, now, ann, Target.Doc(plan), annInvited, "Ann owns the plan: accepting a view invitation to it changes nothing"),
    reject(withCat, now + 7 * day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "a lapsed invitation is never accepted"))

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>

    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

val acceptContract = Node.contract("A person accepts their open invitation to a document or folder: they then have a share of it at the invitation's level, in place of any share of it they had, and the invitation goes. Without an open invitation, or when the document is their own (their share of it is the owner's), nothing changes.",
  why = "Q7: an invitation gives no access until it is accepted, and only while it is open; accepting is what makes the share. Q14: nothing replaces an owner's share of their own document, so an owner invited to it keeps their edit share for good.",
  idea = "Invitations"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
  accept(lib, t, p, what) === lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
    ownedBy(lib, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)).fold(lib,
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what)))))))
  .refines(invitationsAreOffers)
  .examples()(
    allows(withCat, now, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "Cat accepts Ann's invitation, sent a day ago: she may view the plan"),
    allows(withCat, now + 7 * day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), withCat, "eight days after it was sent the invitation has lapsed"),
    allows(withCat, now, bob, Target.Doc(plan), withCat, "Bob was not invited"),
    allows(annInvited, now, ann, Target.Doc(plan), annInvited, "Ann owns the plan: accepting a view invitation to it changes nothing"),
    forbids(withCat, now + 7 * day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "a lapsed invitation is never accepted"))

## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share reaches them and
covers it, and edit it exactly when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is.

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules, expiring
shares, audit logs and outside identity providers are not part of it yet.

## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share in force reaches

access, and the last edit share of a document may be unshared.

values.b7c6dbfa4d7d16d2: At any moment, a person can view a document exactly when it is not in the trash and they may view it, and edit it exactly when it is not in the trash and they may edit it. Only someone who may edit a document or folder changes whom it is shared with or invited to, or moves, trashes or restores a document; a document is restored only before it is gone. An invitation gives no access, and is accepted only while it is open. Housekeeping removes only what has ended: shares no longer in force, invitations no longer open, documents gone and their shares. A share given for good stays in force, an invitation is open when it is sent, and a document not in the trash is never gone.
values.a9a00bae9d0781af: The idea in one statement: the shares in force decide who sees and who changes what (Q1, Q2), the trash hides a document until it is restored (Q8), an invitation is an offer, not a share (Q7), and tidying never takes away anything still in force. The last sentence is all the purpose asks of the lifetimes: without it, nothing ever being in force would meet it. Whether a share is in force, an invitation open or a document gone is left open here: Lifetimes fixes it with the clock below, and this holds whatever it says.

values.20b23518c082e92c: An access request is a person's ask: asking changes nothing shared, offered or kept, so it gives nobody access; only someone who may edit the document answers it, and approving it, while it is pending, makes the share asked for; and housekeeping declines it within one of its periods of its lapsing, and reminds the owner of it within one of its periods of its being due a reminder.
values.a7642b56f4ca9b39: Q12: a person who has no access asks for it, and an editor decides. Whether a request is still pending, or due a reminder, is left open here (Lifetimes: 7 days and 48 hours); that housekeeping acts on time is RequestsAnsweredOnTime's, with the clock.

values.170a734e30f9a801: announce: the library with notices of a change added to its outbox

values.e9c04a898eedcfaa: case class Moment(library: Library, now: BigInt, tidied: BigInt, mailbox: List[Notice])
values.36c556247c00223a: enum Event: case Asked(request: Request), case Housekept, case Delivered, case Waited(seconds: BigInt)
values.207c77445a981ad9:
Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt, Nil): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))
values.eb61786a75892514:
Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = served(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = housekept(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Delivered.type](m.library.outbox.headOption.fold(m)(n =>
        m.copy((library = m.library.copy((outbox = m.library.outbox.filterNot(x => x === n))),
          mailbox = m.mailbox.contains(n).fold(m.mailbox, m.mailbox ++ List(n))))))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))
values.08e2d6715d5306ca:
Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.askCode(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approveCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.declineCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transferCode(lib, t, by, d, to))
values.6d9860fc3e83048d:
Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)
values.ddc759ffe7da2ef5:
Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)
values.1409143d8c8eb053:
Sharing.moveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)
values.d8ff4d38de73842c:
Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))
values.7e74c28f0faf227f:
Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))
values.fe0d735f07960285:
Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)
values.46f977da4b057f6b:
Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))
values.a0a6952d2720ab8d:
Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)
values.a8e830907c0a61db:
Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)
values.b87f02872e3b3b99:
Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)
values.ae90f09b17ff1494:
Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))
values.eb9d15651b6f2163:
AccessRequests.askCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)
values.c96e341380f4f564:
AccessRequests.requestsWithout = (rs: Term[List[AccessRequest]], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)
values.510437950385bf5f:
AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
      mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))
values.fa10d71a0f3dcc84:
AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

## Access requests

gives no access. Anyone who can edit the document approves the request, which

values.a437bcfdc123d551:
Audit.makes = (e: Term[Entry], s: Term[Share]) =>
    e.change
      .on[Change.Made](r => r
        .on[Request.Access]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Share]((_, what, withWhom, level, until) => s === Share(what, withWhom, level, until))
        .on[Request.Unshare]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Move]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Invite]((_, _, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => s.what === what && s.withWhom === Grantee[Grantee.Person](p) && s.until.isEmpty)
        .on[Request.Withdraw]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Trash]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Restore]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Ask]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Approve]((_, p, w) => s.what === w && s.withWhom === Grantee[Grantee.Person](p) && s.until.isEmpty)
        .on[Request.Decline]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Transfer]((_, d, to) => s === Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt])))
      .on[Change.Housekept.type](False)
      .on[Change.Forgotten.type](False)

Invitations, accepted invitations, access requests and their answers,
reminders, and documents handed on are notified to the person they concern.

val approveContract = Node.contract(approve)("ApproveContract",
  "Someone who may edit a document approves a person's pending request for it: the person then has a share of it at the level asked, for good, in place of any share of it they had, and the request goes. Otherwise nothing changes.",
  why = "Q12: approving makes the share; a request that has lapsed can no longer be approved, the person asks again.",
  idea = "Access requests"
)((lib, t, by, p, d, result) =>
  result === lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
        sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)))
  .under(requestsAreAsks)
  .examples()(
    expect(withCatAsking, now, ann, cat, plan, library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares), "Ann approves: Cat may view the plan"),
    expect(withCatAsking, now, bob, cat, plan, withCatAsking, "Bob may not edit the plan: the request stays"),
    expect(withCatAsking, now + 7 * day, ann, cat, plan, withCatAsking, "eight days on the request has lapsed"),
    reject(withCatAsking, now, bob, cat, plan, library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares), "only an editor approves"))

val approveContract = Node.contract("Someone who may edit a document or folder approves a person's pending request for it: the person then has a share of it at the level asked, for good, in place of any share of it they had, and the request goes. Otherwise, or when it is the person's own document (their share of it is the owner's), nothing changes.",
  why = "Q12: approving makes the share; a request that has lapsed can no longer be approved, the person asks again. Q14: nothing replaces an owner's share of their own document.",
  idea = "Access requests"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], w: Term[Target]) =>
  approve(lib, t, by, p, w) === lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.what === w && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, w) && !ownedBy(lib, w, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p))).fold(
      lib.copy((shares = Share(w, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
        sharesWithout(lib.shares, w, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, w))), lib))))
  .refines(accessRequestsAreAsks)
  .examples()(
    allows(withCatAsking, now, ann, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares), "Ann approves: Cat may view the plan"),
    allows(withCatAsking, now, bob, cat, Target.Doc(plan), withCatAsking, "Bob may not edit the plan: the request stays"),
    allows(withCatAsking, now + 7 * day, ann, cat, Target.Doc(plan), withCatAsking, "eight days on the request has lapsed"),
    allows(annAsks, now, ann, ann, Target.Doc(plan), annAsks, "Ann owns the plan: her request for view of it changes nothing"),
    forbids(withCatAsking, now, bob, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares), "only an editor approves"))

  "A person asks for access to a document or a folder at a level: the request, made now, takes the place of any earlier request of theirs for it. Asking for a document or folder that does not exist changes nothing.",
  why = "Q12: anyone named in the library may ask, for a document or a folder; one request per person and document or folder, so asking again renews it.",
  idea = "Access requests"
)((lib, t, p, w, level, result) =>
  result === holds(lib, w).fold(
    lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, w, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, w))), lib))
  .under(requestsAreAsks)
  .examples()(
    expect(library, now - day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), Level.View, withCatAsking, "Cat asks to view the plan"),
    expect(library, now - day, cat, Target.InFolder(reports), Level.View, library.copy(requests = List(catAsksForReports)),
      "Cat asks to view the reports folder"),
    expect(library, now, cat, Target.Doc(DocumentId("nowhere")), Level.View, library, "no such document: nothing changes"),
    never(library, now, cat, Target.Doc(plan), Level.View, library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares), "asking gives no access"))

values.c42827d609f3efff: Every change the service makes is recorded in its log, with the request that made it and when, in the same save as the change; so at every moment, every share the library holds was made by a request in the log. A share is never seen before its entry is there, and every yes of canView rests on shares whose making is logged.
values.c573d31a6776b378: Q15: every change is logged with who, what and when, and every yes of canView is traceable to the log entries of the shares that gave it. Recording the change in the save that makes it is what puts the entry there first (an ordering of the run, assertion 5 of the time design): no moment of the service shows a share whose entry is not already kept. That the log is append-only and kept for a year is the store's (LibraryKept): nothing removes an entry.

Audit.makes = (e: Term[Entry], s: Term[Share]) =>
    e.change
      .on[Change.Made](r => r
        .on[Request.Access]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Share]((_, what, withWhom, level, until) => s === Share(what, withWhom, level, until))
        .on[Request.Unshare]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Move]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Invite]((_, _, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => s.what === what && s.withWhom === Grantee[Grantee.Person](p) && s.until.isEmpty)
        .on[Request.Withdraw]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Trash]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Restore]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Ask]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Approve]((_, p, d) => s.what === Target[Target.Doc](d) && s.withWhom === Grantee[Grantee.Person](p) && s.until.isEmpty)
        .on[Request.Decline]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Transfer]((_, d, to) => s === Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt])))
      .on[Change.Housekept.type](False)

## Audit

change, so no change is seen before its entry. Every yes of "can view" can be

values.34d2f019c45a5e26:
## Audit

Every change is logged with who asked, what and when, in the same save as the
change, so no change is seen before its entry. Every yes of "can view" can be
traced to the log entries of the shares that gave it. Entries are never taken
away; after a year, housekeeping forgets what an entry tells, unless it is the
making of a share still held or of a change a waiting notice tells of.

val chaseContract = Node.contract(chase)("ChaseContract",
  "Housekeeping chases the access requests at a moment: a request no longer pending is declined (it goes, and the person is told); a pending one due a reminder, not reminded yet, is marked reminded and its document's owner is told. Everything else stays as it was.",
  why = "Q12: a reminder after 48 hours, once; declined automatically after 7 days. The notices go to the outbox with the change, so they are sent once it is saved (Q13).",
  idea = "Access requests"
)((lib, t, result) =>
  result === lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)),
    outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t))))
  .under(requestsAreAsks)
  .examples()(
    expect(withCatAsking, now, withCatAsking, "asked a day ago: nothing to do"),
    expect(library.copy(requests = List(catAskedLongAgo)), now,
      library.copy(requests = List(catAskedLongAgo.copy(reminded = true)), outbox = List(Notice(ann, Subject.Reminder(catAskedLongAgo)))),
      "asked three days ago: Ann, the plan's owner, is reminded"),
    expect(withCatAsking, now + 7 * day, library.copy(outbox = List(Notice(cat, Subject.Lapsed(catAsks)))),
      "eight days on: declined, and Cat is told"),
    reject(library.copy(requests = List(catAskedLongAgo.copy(reminded = true))), now,
      library.copy(requests = List(catAskedLongAgo.copy(reminded = true)), outbox = List(Notice(ann, Subject.Reminder(catAskedLongAgo)))),
      "a request is reminded of once"))

        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

val chaseContract = Node.contract("Housekeeping chases the access requests at a moment: a request no longer pending is declined (it goes, and the person is told); a pending one due a reminder, not reminded yet, is marked reminded and the owner of each document it is for is told. Everything else stays as it was.",
  why = "Q12: a reminder after 48 hours, once; declined automatically after 7 days. The notices go to the outbox with the change, so they are sent once it is saved (Q13).",
  idea = "Access requests"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
  chase(lib, t) === lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)),
    outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))))
  .refines(accessRequestsAreAsks)
  .examples()(
    allows(withCatAsking, now, withCatAsking, "asked a day ago: nothing to do"),
    allows(library.copy(requests = List(catAskedLongAgo)), now,
      library.copy(requests = List(catAskedLongAgo.copy(reminded = true)), outbox = List(Notice(ann, Subject.Reminder(catAskedLongAgo)))),
      "asked three days ago: Ann, the plan's owner, is reminded"),
    allows(withCatAsking, now + 7 * day, library.copy(outbox = List(Notice(cat, Subject.Lapsed(catAsks)))),
      "eight days on: declined, and Cat is told"),
    forbids(library.copy(requests = List(catAskedLongAgo.copy(reminded = true))), now,
      library.copy(requests = List(catAskedLongAgo.copy(reminded = true)), outbox = List(Notice(ann, Subject.Reminder(catAskedLongAgo)))),
      "a request is reminded of once"))

## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

val deliveryJob = Node.contract(deliver)("DeliveryJob",
  "A run of delivery sends the oldest notice in the outbox to the mail server, trying three times, a second and then two seconds apart; once the mail server has it, it leaves the outbox. A run that fails leaves the outbox as it was, so the notice is sent again at the next run. Nothing else in the library changes.",
  why = "Q13: at least once, through an outbox, retried with a schedule. A notice the mail server took whose removal from the outbox then failed is sent again and dropped by the mail server (MailerKept): never twice.",
  idea = "Notifications"
)((result, before, after) =>
  before(LibraryModel).outbox.take(1).forall(n => after(MailerModel).contains(n) &&
    after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel).copy((outbox = before(LibraryModel).outbox.filterNot(m => m === n)))) &&
  (before(LibraryModel).outbox.isEmpty ==> (after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel))))
  .onFailure[Failure]((e, before, after) => after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel))
  .under(noticesFollowChanges)
  .examples()(
    expect(at(List(told), Nil), (), at(Nil, List(told)), "Cat's notice delivered"),
    expect(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, true), (), at(Nil, List(told), now + 1), "the mail server was down once: delivered a second later"),
    expect(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, true, true, true), Failed(Failure.MailerUnavailable), at(List(told), Nil, now + 3),
      "down three times: the notice stays in the outbox"),
    expect(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(List(told), List(told)),
      "delivered, but the store failed: the notice stays, to be sent again (and dropped by the mail server)"),
    expect(at(List(told), List(told)), (), at(Nil, List(told)), "sent again after that: not delivered twice"),
    reject(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, true, true, true), Failed(Failure.MailerUnavailable), at(Nil, Nil, now + 3),
      "a notice never leaves the outbox undelivered"))

values.80526a0984edd6fc: A run of delivery reads the outbox and sends the oldest notice of each person in it to the mail server, four at once, each tried three times, a second and then two seconds apart. A notice leaves the outbox only once the mail server has it, and only such a notice: one the mail server did not take stays, to be sent at the next run. The mailbox of each person sent to is as it was, or holds that notice too. Nothing else in the library changes. When the outbox cannot be read, nothing changes.

Q17: up to four at once, order kept per person (one notice of each person a run). Each branch handles its own failures, so one person's notice failing never stops another's; the branches are proven to commute (two people's notices change two mailboxes, and leave the outbox by their own removal), and each removal is one transaction, so a request adding to the outbox meanwhile is kept (Q20).

val deliveryJob = Node.contract(deliver)("DeliveryJob",
  "A run of delivery reads the outbox and sends the oldest notice of each person in it to the mail server, four at once, each tried three times, a second and then two seconds apart. A notice leaves the outbox only once the mail server has it, and only such a notice: one the mail server did not take stays, to be sent at the next run. The mailbox of each person sent to is as it was, or holds that notice too. Nothing else in the library changes. When the outbox cannot be read, nothing changes.",
  why = "Q13: at least once, through an outbox, retried with a schedule; a notice the mail server took whose removal from the outbox then failed is sent again and dropped by the mail server (MailerKept): never twice. Q17: up to four at once, order kept per person (one notice of each person a run). Each branch handles its own failures, so one person's notice failing never stops another's; the branches are proven to commute (two people's notices change two mailboxes, and leave the outbox by their own removal), and each removal is one transaction, so a request adding to the outbox meanwhile is kept (Q20).",
  idea = "Notifications"
)((result, before, after) =>
  let(firstOfEach(before(LibraryModel).outbox))(heads =>
    after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel).copy((outbox = before(LibraryModel).outbox.filter(n => after(LibraryModel).outbox.contains(n)))) &&
    before(LibraryModel).outbox.forall(n => after(LibraryModel).outbox.contains(n) ||
      (heads.contains(n) && mailbox(after(MailerModel), n.to).contains(n))) &&
    heads.forall(n => mailbox(after(MailerModel), n.to) === mailbox(before(MailerModel), n.to) ||
      mailbox(after(MailerModel), n.to) === taken(mailbox(before(MailerModel), n.to), n))))
  .onFailure[Failure]((e, before, after) => after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel) && after(MailerModel) === before(MailerModel))
  .under(noticesFollowChanges)
  .examples()(
    expect(at(List(told), Map.empty), (), at(Nil, boxes(told)), "Cat's notice delivered"),
    expect(at(List(told, toldBob, toldCatAgain), Map.empty), (), at(List(toldCatAgain), boxes(told, toldBob)),
      "Cat's first and Bob's go at once; Cat's second waits for the next run"),
    expect(at(List(told), Map.empty).failing(false, true), (), at(Nil, boxes(told), now + 1), "the mail server was down once: delivered a second later"),
    expect(at(List(told), Map.empty).failing(false, true, true, true), (), at(List(told), Map.empty, now + 3),
      "down three times: the notice stays in the outbox, for the next run"),
    expect(at(List(told), Map.empty).failing(false, false, true), (), at(List(told), boxes(told)),
      "delivered, but the store failed: the notice stays, to be sent again (and dropped by the mail server)"),
    expect(at(List(told), boxes(told)), (), at(Nil, boxes(told)), "sent again after that: not delivered twice"),
    expect(at(List(told), Map.empty).failing(true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(List(told), Map.empty),
      "the outbox cannot be read: nothing changes"),
    reject(at(List(told), Map.empty).failing(false, true, true, true), (), at(Nil, Map.empty, now + 3),
      "a notice never leaves the outbox undelivered"))

val deliveryJob = Node.contract(deliver)("A run of delivery reads the outbox and sends the oldest notice of each person in it to the mail server, four at once, each tried three times, a second and then two seconds apart. A notice leaves the outbox only once the mail server has it, and only such a notice: one the mail server did not take stays, to be sent at the next run. The mailbox of each person sent to is as it was, or holds that notice too. Nothing else in the library changes. When the outbox cannot be read, nothing changes.",
  why = "Q13: at least once, through an outbox, retried with a schedule; a notice the mail server took whose removal from the outbox then failed is sent again and dropped by the mail server (MailerKept): never twice. Q17: up to four at once, order kept per person (one notice of each person a run). Each branch handles its own failures, so one person's notice failing never stops another's; the branches are proven to commute (two people's notices change two mailboxes, and leave the outbox by their own removal), and each removal is one transaction, so a request adding to the outbox meanwhile is kept (Q20).",
  idea = "Notifications"
)((result, before, after) =>
  let(firstOfEach(before(LibraryModel).outbox))(heads =>
    after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel).copy((outbox = before(LibraryModel).outbox.filter(n => after(LibraryModel).outbox.contains(n)))) &&
    before(LibraryModel).outbox.forall(n => after(LibraryModel).outbox.contains(n) ||
      (heads.contains(n) && mailbox(after(MailerModel), n.to).contains(n))) &&
    heads.forall(n => mailbox(after(MailerModel), n.to) === mailbox(before(MailerModel), n.to) ||
      mailbox(after(MailerModel), n.to) === taken(mailbox(before(MailerModel), n.to), n))))
  .onFailure[Failure]((e, before, after) => after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel) && after(MailerModel) === before(MailerModel))
  .refines(noticesFollowChanges)
  .examples()(
    allows(at(List(told), Map.empty), (), at(Nil, boxes(told)), "Cat's notice delivered"),
    allows(at(List(told, toldBob, toldCatAgain), Map.empty), (), at(List(toldCatAgain), boxes(told, toldBob)),
      "Cat's first and Bob's go at once; Cat's second waits for the next run"),
    allows(at(List(told), Map.empty).failing(false, true), (), at(Nil, boxes(told), now + 1), "the mail server was down once: delivered a second later"),
    allows(at(List(told), Map.empty).failing(false, true, true, true), (), at(List(told), Map.empty, now + 3),
      "down three times: the notice stays in the outbox, for the next run"),
    allows(at(List(told), Map.empty).failing(false, false, true), (), at(List(told), boxes(told)),
      "delivered, but the store failed: the notice stays, to be sent again (and dropped by the mail server)"),
    allows(at(List(told), boxes(told)), (), at(Nil, boxes(told)), "sent again after that: not delivered twice"),
    allows(at(List(told), Map.empty).failing(true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(List(told), Map.empty),
      "the outbox cannot be read: nothing changes"),
    forbids(at(List(told), Map.empty).failing(false, true, true, true), (), at(Nil, Map.empty, now + 3),
      "a notice never leaves the outbox undelivered"))

    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = answered(m.library, m.now, r))))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))

## Trash

Deleting a document puts it in the trash, where it gives nobody access, whatever
its shares. Anyone who can edit it can restore it for 30 days, and its shares
hold again. After 30 days it is gone: it can no longer be restored, and
housekeeping deletes it and its shares for good, never before.

val handleContract = Node.contract(handle)("HandleContract",
  "A request is answered from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as Sharing makes it, and answered done when the asker may make it and refused otherwise.",
  why = "This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's terms (LibraryKept). What the answers and changes are is Sharing's (its contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and leaves the one it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change.",
  idea = "Who can see and change what"
)((r, result, before, after) =>
  after(LibraryModel) === afterRequest(before(LibraryModel), r) && result === answerTo(before(LibraryModel), r))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(Request.Access(bob, q3Report), World(LibraryModel -> library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), World(LibraryModel -> library),
      "Bob's team may view the reports folder: Bob can view the Q3 report, and nothing changes"),
    expect(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View), World(LibraryModel -> library), Answer.Done,
      World(LibraryModel -> bobViewsPlan), "Ann shares the plan with Bob: the store holds the new share"),
    expect(Request.Share(bob, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.Edit), World(LibraryModel -> library), Answer.Refused,
      World(LibraryModel -> library), "Bob may not edit the plan: refused, and the store keeps the library"),
    reject(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View), World(LibraryModel -> library), Answer.Done,
      World(LibraryModel -> library), "a change answered done is kept"),
    reject(Request.Access(cat, plan), World(LibraryModel -> library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), World(LibraryModel -> library),
      "Cat has no access to the plan"))

    let lib ← LibraryStore.load
    if ((⟦SharingHttp.afterRequest⟧ lib r) ≠ lib) then

      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level) => Sharing.share(lib, by, what, withWhom, level))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshare(lib, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.move(lib, by, d, into))
SharingHttp.answerTo = (lib: Term[Library], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, by, d, into)))

    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, _, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into)))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, _, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))

      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => allowedWhen(Trash.mayRestore(lib, t, by, d)))
      .on[Request.Ask]((_, d, _) => allowedWhen(lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d)))

## Failures

When the store fails in the middle of a request, the request is answered 503
and changes nothing: each request is one save. A run of housekeeping that fails
changes nothing and is tried again at the next minute; a run of delivery that
fails leaves its notice in the outbox, to be sent again.

SharingHttp.afterRequest = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.share(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshare(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.move(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.accept(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trash(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restore(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.ask(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approve(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.decline(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transfer(lib, t, by, d, to))
SharingHttp.answerTo = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into)))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, _, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => allowedWhen(lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)) &&
        !ownedBy(lib, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p))))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, _, what) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => allowedWhen(Trash.mayRestore(lib, t, by, d)))
      .on[Request.Ask]((_, w, _) => allowedWhen(AccessRequests.holds(lib, w)))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, w) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, w) && !ownedBy(lib, w, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)) &&
        lib.requests.exists(q => q.person === p && q.what === w && isPending(q, t))))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, _, w) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, w)))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => allowedWhen(Ownership.owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
        mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))
Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))
AccessRequests.holds = (lib: Term[Library], w: Term[Target]) =>
    w.on[Target.Doc](d => lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d)).on[Target.InFolder](f => lib.folders.exists(x => x.id === f))
Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

val handleContract = Node.contract(handle)("HandleContract",
  "A request is answered at the time the clock gives, from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as its operation makes it, recorded in the log and announced in the outbox in the same save, and answered done when it may be made and refused otherwise. Handling does not move the clock. A request the store fails changes nothing.",
  why = "This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's and the clock's terms (LibraryKept, ClockKept). What the answers and changes are is the operations' (their contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and the clock once, and leaves the library it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change. One save per request is one transaction: Q16, a store failure mid-request changes nothing, proven for every pattern of the store's failures; the server answers it 503 (ServerWiring).",
  idea = "Failures"
)((r, result, before, after) =>
  after(LibraryModel) === served(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    after(MailerModel) === before(MailerModel) && result === answerTo(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r))
  .failsChangingNothing[Failure]
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(Request.Access(bob, q3Report), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Bob's team may view the reports folder: Bob can view the Q3 report, and nothing changes"),
    expect(shareWithBob, at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(bobViewsPlan), "Ann shares the plan with Bob: the store holds the new share, and its entry in the log"),
    expect(shareWithBob, at(library).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(library),
      "the store fails as the share is saved: nothing changes"),
    never(shareWithBob, at(library).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(bobViewsPlan),
      "a request the store fails is never half kept"),
    expect(Request.Share(bob, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.Edit, None), at(library), Answer.Refused,
      at(library), "Bob may not edit the plan: refused, and the store keeps the library"),
    never(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(library), "a change answered done is kept"),
    never(Request.Access(cat, plan), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Cat has no access to the plan"))

val jobContract = Node.contract(housekeep)("HousekeepingJob",
  "A run of housekeeping leaves the store holding the library it held, tidied, its old log entries forgotten, its access requests chased and the shares ending in a day told of, at the time the clock gives, and, when that changed it, recorded in the log; it does not move the clock. A run that fails changes nothing, and the next minute's run tries again.",
  why = "The job is how tidying, forgetting, chasing and telling of ending shares reach the store; one transaction (Q19). Proven of its flow from the store's and the clock's models (LibraryKept, ClockKept), for every pattern of the store's failures; how often it runs is the scheduler's (HousekeepingOnTime). Q16: a failed run changes nothing until one succeeds.",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)((result, before, after) =>
  let(Notifications.warn(AccessRequests.chase(Audit.forget(tidy(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now), before(ClockModel).now),
    before(ClockModel).now), before(ClockModel).now))(next =>
    after(LibraryModel) === (next =!= before(LibraryModel)).fold(Audit.record(next, before(ClockModel).now, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]),
      before(LibraryModel))) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    after(MailerModel) === before(MailerModel))
  .failsChangingNothing[Failure]
  .under(sharing.time.Deadlines.trashPurgedOnTime, sharing.time.Deadlines.invitationsLapseOnTime, sharing.time.Deadlines.requestsAnsweredOnTime)
  .examples()(
    expect(at(ended, now + 3600), (), at(tidiedAnHourOn, now + 3600), "an hour on: Bob's share goes, and the run is logged"),
    expect(at(ended, now), (), at(ended, now), "nothing has ended yet: nothing to log"),
    expect(at(ended, now + 3600).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(ended, now + 3600),
      "the store fails as the run saves: nothing changes, the next run tries again"),
    reject(at(ended, now + 3600), (), at(ended, now + 3600), "a run removes what has ended"),
    reject(at(ended, now + 3600).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(tidiedAnHourOn, now + 3600),
      "a failed run changes nothing"))

      pure ()

val housekeepingJob = Node.contract(housekeep)("A run of housekeeping leaves the store holding the library it held, tidied, its old log entries forgotten, its access requests chased and the shares ending in a day told of, at the time the clock gives, and, when that changed it, recorded in the log; it does not move the clock. A run that fails changes nothing, and the next minute's run tries again.",
  why = "The job is how tidying, forgetting, chasing and telling of ending shares reach the store; one transaction (Q19). Proven of its flow from the store's and the clock's models (LibraryKept, ClockKept), for every pattern of the store's failures; how often it runs is the scheduler's (HousekeepingOnTime). Q16: a failed run changes nothing until one succeeds.",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)((result, before, after) =>
  let(Notifications.warn(AccessRequests.chase(Audit.forget(tidy(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now), before(ClockModel).now),
    before(ClockModel).now), before(ClockModel).now))(next =>
    after(LibraryModel) === (next =!= before(LibraryModel)).fold(Audit.record(next, before(ClockModel).now, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]),
      before(LibraryModel))) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    after(MailerModel) === before(MailerModel))
  .failsChangingNothing[Failure]
  .refines(sharing.time.Deadlines.trashPurgedOnTime, sharing.time.Deadlines.invitationsLapseOnTime, sharing.time.Deadlines.requestsAnsweredOnTime)
  .examples()(
    allows(at(ended, now + 3600), (), at(tidiedAnHourOn, now + 3600), "an hour on: Bob's share goes, and the run is logged"),
    allows(at(ended, now), (), at(ended, now), "nothing has ended yet: nothing to log"),
    allows(at(ended, now + 3600).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(ended, now + 3600),
      "the store fails as the run saves: nothing changes, the next run tries again"),
    forbids(at(ended, now + 3600), (), at(ended, now + 3600), "a run removes what has ended"),
    forbids(at(ended, now + 3600).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(tidiedAnHourOn, now + 3600),
      "a failed run changes nothing"))

# Sharing documents

People keep documents in folders and share them with other people, or with
teams. The shares decide who can view a document and who can edit it, and who
may change whom it is shared with.

From: Q1, Q5

## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share reaches them and
covers it, and edit it exactly when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is.

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules, expiring
shares, audit logs and outside identity providers are not part of it yet.

From: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5

# Sharing documents

People keep documents in folders and share them with other people, or with
teams. The shares decide who can view a document and who can edit it, and who
may change whom it is shared with. Shares can end, invitations lapse, and
documents in the trash are deleted for good after a while.

From: Q1, Q5

## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share in force reaches
them and covers it and the document is not in the trash, and edit it exactly
when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is. Moving a document out of a folder may take away the mover's own
access, and the last edit share of a document may be unshared.

From: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q10, Q11

## Expiring shares

A share may be given until a time. From that time on it gives no access,
whether or not housekeeping has removed it yet: access is worked out from the
clock when it is asked. Sharing again replaces the end time.

From: Q6

## Invitations

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can invite a person to it, at a level,
and withdraw the invitation. An invitation gives no access until the person
accepts it; accepting it makes the share. An invitation can be accepted for 7
days after it is sent; then it lapses, and housekeeping removes it.

From: Q7

## Trash

Deleting a document puts it in the trash, where it gives nobody access, whatever
its shares. Anyone who can edit it can restore it for 30 days, and its shares
hold again. After 30 days it is gone: it can no longer be restored, and
housekeeping deletes it and its shares for good, never before.

From: Q8

## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

From: Q9

## Serving

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules, audit logs and
outside identity providers are not part of it yet.

From: Q5

From: Q9

## Serving

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules and outside
identity providers are not part of it yet.

From: Q5

## Access requests

Anyone named in the library can ask for view or edit on a document. Asking
gives no access. Anyone who can edit the document approves the request, which
makes the share asked for, or declines it. A request nobody answers is
reminded of to the document's owner after 48 hours, once, and declined
automatically after 7 days; housekeeping does both.

From: Q12

## Ownership

Every document has exactly one owner. Only the owner, while they can edit it,
hands it on, and only to someone who can edit it; the new owner then has an
edit share of it for good. Nobody can unshare an owner's own share of their
document, so the owner always can edit it, and leaving a team never takes their
documents from them.

From: Q14

## Audit

Every change is logged with who asked, what and when, in the same save as the
change, so no change is seen before its entry. Every yes of "can view" can be
traced to the log entries of the shares that gave it. The log only grows.

From: Q15

## Notifications

Invitations, accepted invitations, access requests and their answers,
reminders, and documents handed on are notified to the person they concern.
Each notice goes to an outbox in the same save as its change, and is sent from
there, retried until the mail server has it: a person is told of each event at
least once and never twice, because the mail server keeps each event once.

From: Q13

## Failures

When the store fails in the middle of a request, the request is answered 503
and changes nothing: each request is one save. A run of housekeeping that fails
changes nothing and is tried again at the next minute; a run of delivery that
fails leaves its notice in the outbox, to be sent again.

From: Q16

gives no access. Anyone who can edit the document approves the request, which
makes the share asked for, or declines it. A request nobody answers is
reminded of to the document's owner after 48 hours, once, and declined
automatically after 7 days; housekeeping does both.

## Ownership

Every document has exactly one owner. Only the owner, while they can edit it,

reminders, and documents handed on are notified to the person they concern.

and changes nothing: each request is one save. A run of housekeeping that fails

val inviteContract = Node.contract(invite)("InviteContract",
  "Someone who may edit a document or folder invites a person to it at a level: the invitation, sent now, takes the place of any earlier invitation of them to it. When anyone else asks, nothing changes.",
  why = "Q7: an invitation is how someone gets a share they have not asked for yet; inviting is offering a share, which only someone who may share it does. One invitation per person and thing, so inviting again renews it.",
  idea = "Invitations"
)((lib, t, by, to, what, level, result) =>
  result === mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(
    lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(library, now - day, ann, cat, Target.Doc(plan), Level.View, withCat, "Ann may edit the plan: she invites Cat to view it"),
    expect(library, now, bob, cat, Target.Doc(plan), Level.View, library, "Bob may not edit the plan: nothing changes"),
    reject(library, now, bob, cat, Target.InFolder(reports), Level.View,
      library.copy(invitations = List(Invitation(cat, Target.InFolder(reports), Level.View, bob, now))),
      "Bob may only view the reports folder, so he cannot invite anyone to it"))

val moveContract = Node.contract(move)("MoveContract",
  "Someone who may edit a document moves it into a folder they may edit, or out of every folder: the document is then in that folder and in every folder around it. When anyone else asks, or the folder does not exist, nothing changes.",
  why = "Moving a document changes who may see it, through the folders' shares (Cover), so it needs the right to edit both the document and the folder it goes into.",
  idea = "Who can see and change what"
)((lib, by, d, into, result) =>
  result === mayMove(lib, by, d, into).fold(
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = foldersAt(lib, into))), doc)))),
    lib))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(library, ann, plan, Some(reports),
      library.copy(documents = List(Document(plan, "Plan", List(reports)), Document(q3Report, "Q3 report", List(reports, q3)))),
      "Ann may edit the plan and the reports folder: the plan moves into it"),
    expect(library, bob, q3Report, None, library, "Bob may only view the Q3 report: it stays where it is"),
    reject(library, ann, plan, Some(FolderId("nowhere")),
      library.copy(documents = List(Document(plan, "Plan", List(FolderId("nowhere"))), Document(q3Report, "Q3 report", List(reports, q3)))),
      "a document never moves into a folder that does not exist"))

val moveContract = Node.contract(move)("MoveContract",
  "Someone who may edit a document moves it into a folder they may edit, or out of every folder: the document is then in that folder and in every folder around it. When anyone else asks, or the folder does not exist, nothing changes.",
  why = "Moving a document changes who may see it, through the folders' shares (Cover), so it needs the right to edit both the document and the folder it goes into.",
  idea = "Who can see and change what"
)((lib, t, by, d, into, result) =>
  result === mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = foldersAt(lib, into))), doc)))),
    lib))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(library, now, ann, plan, Some(reports),
      library.copy(documents = List(planDoc.copy(folders = List(reports)), q3ReportDoc)),
      "Ann may edit the plan and the reports folder: the plan moves into it"),
    expect(library, now, bob, q3Report, None, library, "Bob may only view the Q3 report: it stays where it is"),
    never(library, now, ann, plan, Some(FolderId("nowhere")),
      library.copy(documents = List(planDoc.copy(folders = List(FolderId("nowhere"))), q3ReportDoc)),
      "a document never moves into a folder that does not exist"))

hands it on, and only to someone who can edit it; the new owner then has an

val ownersKeepTheirDocuments = Node.claim("A document has one owner. Only its owner, while they may edit it, hands it on, and only to someone who may edit it, who then has an edit share of it for good; and nobody unshares or replaces an owner's shares of their own document. An owner's share is with them in person, not through a team, so leaving a team never takes their documents from them.",
  why = "Q14: every document has exactly one owner, its creator; only the owner transfers it, to someone who may edit it; the owner always may edit; an owner leaving a team keeps their documents; the owner's share cannot be unshared or expire. Exactly one owner is the type: a document names its owner.",
  idea = "Ownership"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], to: Term[PersonId]) =>
  transfer(lib, t, by, d, to) =!= lib implies
    (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      owns(transfer(lib, t, by, d, to), to, d) &&
      transfer(lib, t, by, d, to).shares.contains(Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt])))) &&
  forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom) implies (Sharing.unshare(lib, t, by, what, withWhom) === lib)) &&
  forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    ownedBy(lib, s.what, s.withWhom) implies (Sharing.share(lib, t, by, s) === lib)))
  .refines(accessFollowsShares)

val restoreContract = Node.contract(restore)("RestoreContract",
  "Someone who may edit a document restores it from the trash before it is gone: it is out of the trash, and its shares give access again. When anyone else asks, or it is not in the trash, or it is gone, nothing changes.",
  why = "Q8: a document in the trash can be restored until it is gone; its shares stayed, so restoring brings back exactly the access it had.",
  idea = "Trash"
)((lib, t, by, d, result) =>
  result === mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib))
  .under(trashUntilGone)
  .examples()(
    expect(planInTrash, now, ann, plan, library, "a day in the trash: Ann restores the plan"),
    expect(planInTrash, now + 29 * day, ann, plan, planInTrash, "thirty days in the trash: it is gone"),
    expect(planInTrash, now, bob, plan, planInTrash, "Bob may not edit the plan"),
    never(planInTrash, now + 40 * day, ann, plan, library, "a document gone is never restored"))

val shareContract = Node.contract(share)("ShareContract",
  "Someone who may edit a document or folder shares it with a person or a team at a level, for good or until a time: the new share takes the place of any earlier share of it with them, unless it is the owner's share of their own document, which stays. When anyone else asks, nothing changes.",
  why = "Anyone who can edit a document can share it (Q2), and a person or team has one share of a thing at a time, so sharing again changes the level and the end rather than adding a second share (Q6); the owner's own share is not replaced, so it never becomes a view share or one that ends (Q14).",
  idea = "Who can see and change what"
)((lib, t, by, s, result) =>
  result === (mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what) && !ownedBy(lib, s.what, s.withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib))
  .under(accessFollowsShares, sharing.ownership.Ownership.ownersKeepTheirDocuments)
  .examples()(
    expect(library, now, ann, bobViewsPlan, library.copy(shares = bobViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "Ann may edit the plan, so she shares it with Bob"),
    expect(library, now, ann, bobViewsPlanForAnHour, library.copy(shares = bobViewsPlanForAnHour :: library.shares),
      "Ann shares the plan with Bob for an hour"),
    expect(library, now, bob, Share(Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.Edit, None), library,
      "Bob may not edit the plan: his request changes nothing"),
    never(library, now, bob, catViewsReports, library.copy(shares = catViewsReports :: library.shares),
      "Bob may only view the reports folder, so he cannot share it"),
    expect(library.copy(shares = bobEditsPlan :: library.shares), now, bob, Share(Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(ann), Level.View, Some(now + 3600)),
      library.copy(shares = bobEditsPlan :: library.shares), "Bob may edit the plan, but Ann owns it: her edit share stays as it is"))

val tidyContract = Node.contract(tidy)("TidyContract",
  "Tidying at a moment keeps the shares in force, except those of a document gone; keeps the invitations still open; and keeps the documents not gone. Everything else stays as it was.",
  why = "Q6–Q8: ended shares and lapsed invitations give nothing and are removed; a document 30 days in the trash is deleted for good, with its shares (Q8), so they cannot come back to anything. The folders and teams are not touched.",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)((lib, t, result) =>
  result === lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
    shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
    invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t)))))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(ended, now, ended, "nothing has ended yet"),
    expect(ended, now + 3600, ended.copy(shares = library.shares), "Bob's share of the plan has ended"),
    expect(ended, now + 29 * day, library.copy(documents = List(q3ReportDoc), shares = List(annEditsReports, engViewsReports)),
      "a month on: the invitation has lapsed, and the plan is gone with its shares"),
    reject(ended, now, library, "nothing is removed before its time"))

      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

val tidyContract = Node.contract(tidy)("TidyContract",
  "Tidying at a moment keeps the shares in force, except those of a document gone; keeps the invitations still open; and keeps the documents not gone. Everything else stays as it was.",
  why = "Q6–Q8: ended shares and lapsed invitations give nothing and are removed; a document 30 days in the trash is deleted for good, with its shares (Q8), so they cannot come back to anything. The folders and teams are not touched.",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)((lib, t, result) =>
  result === lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
    shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
    invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t)))))
  .under(clearsOnlyTheEnded)
  .examples()(
    expect(ended, now, ended, "nothing has ended yet"),
    expect(ended, now + 3600, ended.copy(shares = library.shares), "Bob's share of the plan has ended"),
    expect(ended, now + 29 * day, library.copy(documents = List(q3ReportDoc), shares = List(annEditsReports, engViewsReports)),
      "a month on: the invitation has lapsed, and the plan is gone with its shares"),
    never(ended, now, library, "nothing is removed before its time"))

values.095e8a089b7fbe60:
## Concurrency

Many people use the service at once. Each request, and each run of
housekeeping, is one transaction on the store: two requests on one document at
once leave it as one after the other does, in the order they were made to the
store, and housekeeping comes before or after a request, never in the middle.
Delivery runs beside the requests: it only takes notices out of the outbox,
each in a transaction of its own, while requests only add to it. The service is
one process with one store.

val transferContract = Node.contract(transfer)("TransferContract",
  "The owner of a document, while they may edit it, hands it on to someone who may edit it: that person is then its owner, with an edit share of it for good in place of any share of it they had. When anyone else asks, or the new owner may not edit it, nothing changes.",
  why = "Q14: only the owner transfers a document, to someone who may edit it; the new owner's share makes sure they always may edit it.",
  idea = "Ownership"
)((lib, t, by, d, to, result) =>
  result === (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))).fold(
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((owner = to)), doc)),
      shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt]) ::
        sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to)))), lib))
  .under(ownersKeepTheirDocuments)
  .examples()(
    expect(bobMayEdit, now, ann, plan, bob,
      library.copy(documents = List(planDoc.copy(owner = bob), q3ReportDoc), shares = bobEditsPlan :: library.shares),
      "Ann hands the plan on to Bob, who may edit it"),
    expect(library, now, ann, plan, bob, library, "Bob may not edit the plan: Ann keeps it"),
    expect(bobMayEdit, now, bob, plan, cat, bobMayEdit, "Bob does not own the plan"),
    reject(bobMayEdit, now, bob, plan, bob,
      bobMayEdit.copy(documents = List(planDoc.copy(owner = bob), q3ReportDoc)), "only the owner hands a document on"))

val trashContract = Node.contract(trash)("TrashContract",
  "Someone who may edit a document puts it in the trash: it is in the trash from now on, unless it was already, when it keeps the time it was put there. When anyone else asks, nothing changes.",
  why = "Q8: deleting a document puts it in the trash for a while rather than deleting it for good. Deleting is a change to the document, so only someone who may edit it does it.",
  idea = "Trash"
)((lib, t, by, d, result) =>
  result === mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib))
  .under(trashUntilGone)
  .examples()(
    expect(library, now - day, ann, plan, planInTrash, "Ann may edit the plan: it goes to the trash"),
    expect(planInTrash, now, ann, plan, planInTrash, "already in the trash: it keeps its time"),
    expect(library, now, bob, plan, library, "Bob may not edit the plan"),
    reject(library, now, bob, q3Report, library.copy(documents = List(planDoc, q3ReportDoc.copy(trashed = Some(now)))),
      "Bob may only view the Q3 report: he cannot delete it"))

values.1ac784401b1f611f: Q8: a document in the trash can be restored for 30 days, then it is deleted for good.
values.256677fe8b929143: A document in the trash is purged after 30 days and never before: housekeeping removes only documents 30 days in the trash, and while it runs at least every two minutes no document stays in the trash longer than 30 days and two minutes.
values.c4930e3105584084: Q8, as a safety (never before: each run of housekeeping) and a bounded response (after: every moment the service reaches, given the scheduler's period, HousekeepingOnTime). Unbounded "eventually purged" is weaker and could not be tested.

val trashPurgedOnTime = Node.claim("TrashPurgedOnTime",
  "A document in the trash is purged after 30 days and never before: housekeeping removes only documents 30 days in the trash, and while it runs at least every two minutes no document stays in the trash longer than 30 days and two minutes.",
  why = "Q8, as a safety (never before: each run of housekeeping) and a bounded response (after: every moment the service reaches, given the scheduler's period, HousekeepingOnTime). Unbounded \"eventually purged\" is weaker and could not be tested.",
  idea = "Trash"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
  lib.documents.forall(doc => Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t).documents.contains(doc) || doc.trashed.fold(False)(at => at + trashKeeps <= t))) &&
  after(events).library.documents.forall(doc => doc.trashed.fold(True)(at => after(events).now < at + trashKeeps + housekeepingWithin)))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)

values.91d4c90e6a6366bc: Only someone who may edit a document puts it in the trash or takes it out, and only before it is gone; and housekeeping purges it within one of its periods of its being gone.
values.2b272533ad82dce6: Q8: the trash is a delay before deleting: what is in it can be brought back until it is gone, and not after. Whether it is gone is left open here (Lifetimes); that a gone document does not linger is what TrashPurgedOnTime says with the clock.

val unshareContract = Node.contract("Someone who may edit a document or folder unshares it from a person or a team: their share of it goes, unless it is the owner's share of their own document. When anyone else asks, nothing changes.",
  why = "Unsharing is changing who a document is shared with, which only someone who may edit it does (Q2); the owner's own share stays, so the owner always may edit (Q14).",
  idea = "Who can see and change what"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
  unshare(lib, t, by, what, withWhom) === (mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)))
  .refines(accessFollowsShares, sharing.ownership.Ownership.ownersKeepTheirDocuments)
  .examples()(
    allows(library, now, ann, Target.InFolder(reports), Grantee.Team(eng), library.copy(shares = List(annEditsPlan, annEditsReports)),
      "Ann may edit the reports folder, so she unshares it from the engineering team"),
    allows(library, now, bob, Target.InFolder(reports), Grantee.Team(eng), library,
      "Bob may only view the folder: his request changes nothing"),
    allows(library.copy(shares = bobEditsPlan :: library.shares), now, bob, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(ann),
      library.copy(shares = bobEditsPlan :: library.shares), "Bob may edit the plan, but Ann owns it: her share stays"),
    forbids(library, now, bob, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(ann), library.copy(shares = List(annEditsReports, engViewsReports)),
      "Bob cannot take Ann's share of the plan away"))

val warnContract = Node.contract(warn)("WarnContract",
  "Housekeeping tells of the shares ending within a day: at a moment, it adds at the end of the outbox a notice, to each person a share reaches, of each share whose end comes a day on, within one housekeeping period. Nothing else changes.",
  why = "Q13 as assumed: shares ending within a day are notified. Housekeeping runs every minute and never two minutes apart (HousekeepingOnTime), so a share's end falls in the window of one run or two; the mail server keeps a notice once (MailerKept), so each person is told once.",
  idea = "Notifications"
)((lib, t, result) => result === lib.copy((outbox = lib.outbox ++ endingNotices(lib, t))))
  .under(noticesFollowChanges)
  .examples()(
    expect(library.copy(shares = bobsHourEndsInADay :: library.shares), now,
      library.copy(shares = bobsHourEndsInADay :: library.shares, outbox = List(Notice(bob, Subject.Ending(bobsHourEndsInADay)))),
      "Bob's share ends in a day: he is told"),
    expect(library.copy(shares = bobsHourEndsInADay :: library.shares), now - 3600, library.copy(shares = bobsHourEndsInADay :: library.shares),
      "a day and an hour before: not yet"),
    reject(library.copy(shares = bobsHourEndsInADay :: library.shares), now, library.copy(shares = bobsHourEndsInADay :: library.shares),
      "a share ending is never left untold"))

Notifications.warnCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((outbox = lib.outbox ++ endingNotices(lib, t)))
Notifications.endingNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.shares.filter(s => endsInADay(s, t)).flatMap(s => reachedBy(lib, s).map(p => Notice(p, Subject[Subject.Ending](s))))
Notifications.reachedBy = (lib: Term[Library], s: Term[Share]) =>
    s.withWhom.on[Grantee.Person](p => List(p)).on[Grantee.Team](t => lib.teams.filter(team => team.id === t).flatMap(team => team.members))
Notifications.endsInADay = (s: Term[Share], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    s.until.exists(u => u <= t + day && u > t + day - window)
